description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Differential Bearing Kit – LEVEL 2 – for the SJ413 / Suzuki Samurai 86-95
Fits the Front or Rear Differential
Quality Bearings made to Japanese Standards.
Puts Everything you Need to Complete the Install in One Affordable Kit!
Direct Replacement
Level 2 Kit Includes:
Bearings:
Qty 1 – Pinion (Inner) Bearing
Qty 1 – Outer Bearing
Qty 2 – Side Bearings
Oil Seal:
Qty 1 (Behind Flange)
Shims:
9 pc Set – Varying Thickness
Nut:
Qty 1 – Pinion Nut
Spacer:
Qty 1 – Spacer Bevel Pinion
Marking Kit:
Qty 1 – Brush
Qty 1 – Paint (yellow)
Washers:
8 pc Set – Pinion Gear Washers (1.0mm)
8 pc Set – Pinion Gear Washers (1.5mm)
Thrust Washers:
4 pc Set – Thrust Washers (1.0mm)
4 pc Set – Thrust Washers (1.5mm)
Qty 4 – Pinion Gears
Qty 1 – #1 Pinion Shaft
Qty 2 – #2 Pinion Shaft
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Level 2 Differential Kit (see above)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
